metric_definitions.admission_latency: Same content/terminal endpoints minus request journal admission.monotonic.
metric_definitions.independent_unit: PAIR, with exactly two pairs per read schedule; schedule aggregate is median of two paired ratios, not a pooled request statistic.
metric_definitions.native_ttft_seconds: First nonempty client content event minus client sent_at; not first GPU-token latency.
metric_definitions.phase_W: First measured client_dispatch_at to last measured client terminal ended_at; includes inter-request gaps and failures.
metric_definitions.phase_qualified_goodput: Reference-qualified measured completion tokens / phase W, only when the entire lifecycle and pair qualify.
metric_definitions.serialized_service_rate: 40 / sum of five measured native E2E values; request-only service-normalized rate, NOT phase-W goodput.
